title: Salt Water
victim: Monkey D. Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates
teaser: A storm has driven everyone onto the floating restaurant Baratie: pirates, Marines, bounty hunters. Not a single boat will leave its side until morning. At 02:40 the cook went down to the hold for live fish and found Captain Luffy in the fish tank. The water there is only waist-deep, but Luffy ate a Devil Fruit, and the sea drains the strength of those who have. A seastone cuff is snapped round his wrist, and a straw hat floats on the water.

habits.label: Drinks from a coconut
habits.habit: Carries coconuts everywhere and drinks from them through a straw
clues: A split coconut, still moist inside, lies by the fish tank. The culprit drinks from a coconut.
The dishwasher was standing at the pots with his back to the hatch and suddenly caught the sweet smell of coconut: someone went down behind him. The culprit drinks from a coconut.

habits.label: Snail in the pocket
habits.habit: Keeps a little Den Den Mushi in their pocket
clues: A fresh trail of slime, like a Den Den Mushi leaves, glistens on the ladder steps. The culprit keeps a snail in their pocket.
At about half past two a soft "puru-puru-puru" came from the hold and broke off at once, as if a hand had covered a pocket. The culprit keeps a snail in their pocket.

habits.label: Meat on the bone
habits.habit: Only eats meat straight off the bone
clues: A ham bone gnawed clean lies on the lid of the salt barrel. The culprit eats meat straight off the bone.
The cook left a platter of hams in the kitchen for the morning. Now it's empty, and drops of fat lead to the hatch to the hold. The culprit eats meat straight off the bone.

habits.label: Parrot on the shoulder
habits.habit: Never parted from the parrot on their shoulder
clues: A bright green feather lies on the wet boards by the fish tank. The culprit has a parrot on their shoulder.
The cabin boy heard a hoarse bird voice from the hold: "Gone! Gone!" The culprit has a parrot on their shoulder.

habits.label: Drinks rum
habits.habit: Keeps a flask of rum in their belt and takes a swig every half hour
clues: The stopper from a flask lies under the ladder, and it smells of rum. The culprit drinks rum.
A sticky puddle is drying on the boards by the fish tank, and it reeks of cane rum. The culprit drinks rum.

habits.label: Seasick
habits.habit: Suffers from seasickness and turns green in a swell
clues: A packet of dried ginger, the kind chewed for seasickness, fell on a ladder step. The culprit gets seasick.
A guest who couldn't sleep in the storm saw someone just before half past two making their way to the hatch, clinging to the bulkhead and groaning at the rolling. The culprit gets seasick.

habits.label: Kohl-lined eyes
habits.habit: Lines their eyes heavily with black kohl
clues: A napkin smeared with black kohl, the kind used to line eyes, is floating in the fish tank. The culprit lines their eyes.
A waiter noticed a face with heavily lined eyes by the hatch: in the lantern light they looked completely black. The culprit lines their eyes.

habits.label: Anchor tattoo
habits.habit: A fresh anchor tattoo on their arm
clues: A waiter putting out the lamps saw a rolled-up sleeve by the hatch and an anchor tattooed on the arm. The culprit has an anchor tattoo.
There's a rag in the hold with fresh ink and drops of blood on it: that happens when a tattoo is new and still weeping. The culprit has an anchor tattoo.

habits.label: Cloak over the shoulders
habits.habit: Wears a cloak over their shoulders without putting their arms in the sleeves
clues: A guest dozing by the fireplace saw a figure in a cloak walk to the hatch, its empty sleeves swinging. The culprit wears a cloak over their shoulders.
The edge of the fish tank has a wet stripe from a hem: a long cloak hung right down to the water. The culprit wears a cloak over their shoulders.

habits.label: Striped sailor's shirt
habits.habit: Never takes off a striped sailor's shirt
clues: A waiter saw a striped back, blue and white, by the hatch in the lantern light. The culprit wears a striped sailor's shirt.
Luffy has blue and white fibres under his nails: he managed to grab someone's clothes. The culprit wears a striped sailor's shirt.

habits.label: Waxed moustache
habits.habit: Twirls their moustache with wax so it points upwards
clues: A blob of scented moustache wax is stuck to the ladder rail. The culprit has a waxed moustache.
The cabin boy saw a shadow by the hatch with a dashing upturned moustache. The culprit has a waxed moustache.

habits.label: Shell necklace
clues: At the bottom of the fish tank, next to Luffy, lies a drilled shell on a scrap of cord. The culprit wears a shell necklace.
Shells from a broken string are scattered down the ladder: three on the steps, one right by the hatch. The culprit wears a shell necklace.

habits.label: Hook for a hand
habits.habit: An iron hook instead of a hand
clues: The edge of the fish tank has fresh curved notches, like from an iron hook. The culprit has a hook for a hand.
The rope holding down the tank lid is frayed in the middle, as if it was pulled with a hook. The culprit has a hook for a hand.

habits.label: Smells of gunpowder
habits.habit: Always smells of gunpowder, even at dinner
clues: The ladder rail has black dust that smells of sulphur. It's gunpowder. The culprit smells of gunpowder.
A waiter noticed the hatch smelled of gunpowder, as if after a shot, though nobody had fired. The culprit smells of gunpowder.

habits.label: Fishing rod on the back
habits.habit: Never parted from their fishing rod, even at the table
clues: A fishhook with a bit of line is caught on a ladder step. The culprit never goes without their fishing rod.
The tank lid was propped with a rod: the wet wood bears a long mark with the print of a reel. The culprit never goes without their fishing rod.

habits.label: Chews hot peppers
habits.habit: Carries hot chilli pods in their pocket and nibbles them like seeds
clues: A bitten red chilli pod lies by the fish tank. The culprit chews hot peppers.
The handle of the hatch to the hold is smeared with chilli juice: the cook touched it, rubbed his eyes and is still crying. The culprit chews hot peppers.

strong: A ladder step cracked under double weight: Luffy was carried down on someone's shoulder. The culprit is physically strong.
The oak lid of the fish tank usually takes two to lift, yet it was opened and closed single-handed without a single drag mark. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The kitchen hatch creaks so loudly that the cook wakes to it even in a storm. That night he was sleeping right in the kitchen and heard nothing. The culprit moves silently.
Empty bottles stand under the ladder: knock one and they all clink. In the dark someone got round them without touching a single one. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The other cuff is snapped onto a bracket in the bottom of the tank. The bracket was screwed in tonight: the screws are new and still shiny. The culprit is good with their hands.
The rope on the tank lid is tied with a knot that tightens if pulled from inside. The culprit is good with their hands.
medic: Pufferfish liver was found in the remains of Luffy's supper. In a small dose it doesn't kill, it paralyses. The culprit knows about poisons.
A bottle of ether is missing from the ship's doctor's chest, and Luffy's collar still smells sweetish. The culprit knows about poisons.
keys: The Marines keep the seastone cuffs in a locked box. The lock is intact, without a scratch, and one pair is missing. The culprit had a key.
Before bed the owner padlocks the hatch himself. The cook found the padlock shut as always, yet Luffy was already down below. The culprit had a key.
safe: The killer chose exactly the half hour when the storm was at its worst. Only someone who can read the sky could have guessed that time. The culprit knows the sea.
Luffy's boat was cast off at lowest tide, when the current carries everything out to open sea: in the morning people would think he'd sailed off himself. The culprit knows the sea.
sched: The night shift of waiters goes to bed at two, and the cook only goes down for fish at half past. The culprit knows the restaurant routine.

Luffy was lured into the hold by being told the leftovers from the banquet were taken down there. That really does happen every night, but guests would have no way of knowing. The culprit knows the restaurant routine.
tech: The Den Den Mushi the Marines use to call their ship was covered with a wet rag and fell asleep. There was no way to call for help. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The pump that brings seawater into the tank was reset: the drain was shut, and the water rose higher than usual. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cash: The night watchman by the hatch was slipped a handful of gold coins and went to bed early. The culprit has money.
The fish supplier was sent a note and fifty thousand berries in advance not to sail over before noon. The culprit has money.
passages: Wet footprints lead from the tank not to the ladder but to the wall, and stop at the planking. Behind the boards there's a hollow running right up to the deck. The culprit knows the secret passages.
You can climb out of the hold through the shaft the side fin decks slide out of. Only the Baratie's old hands remember it. The culprit knows the secret passages.
